headline: Scopes Convicted in Tennessee Evolution Trial; Teacher Found Guilty Under Butler Act
dispatch: A Dayton, Tennessee jury delivered its verdict this morning, finding biology teacher John Scopes guilty of violating the Butler Act by teaching the theory of evolution in a public school classroom. Judge John Raulston imposed a fine of one hundred dollars. The trial drew national attention and pitted attorney Clarence Darrow against former secretary of state William Jennings Bryan, exposing a deep national divide over science and religion in public education.
answer: John Scopes found guilty of teaching evolution, 1925
